about: Ordered parity scenarios for ndXplorer (Qt baseline -> emtk port). Each scenario is replayed on a fresh 1400x900 main window. Captures: <id>.png is the main window at the end (name 'main'); <id>--<name>.png are extra shots of dialogs/menus/panels. Ops are interpreted by tools/parity/capture_qt.py; see tools/parity/README.md for the op vocabulary and the file-name contract.

mfd.what: Burst-analysis folder (bi4_bur + bg4 + br4 companions), 12237 bursts of a dsDNA smFRET MFD measurement. Default axes Tau (green) vs Proximity ratio show a FRET population plus a donor-only population.

bur_small.what: Single Seidel .bur file (sliding-window burst search); tiny (11 rows) - exercises the single-file / CLI open path, not a meaningful plot.

iris.what: Fisher's iris as CSV with an integer 'class' column: the dataset where 'Find informative projections' (class separation) and clustering have a known answer.

sampling.what: ChiSurf-Sampling folder (m_0/m_1/m_2.er4): MCMC samples of a fit (chi2, rho_1, lb, sc, ts, xL1, b_1, tL1, bg).

mfd_hdf5.what: Photon-HDF5 file, not a columnar ndX table: the Analysis-file import rejects it with 'Data Load Error' (used to record the error path).

image_h5.what: MFIS image table (x/y pixel, Frame, photon counts, Tau, phasor g/s; 449,532 rows, 10 frames of 256x256) generated by tools/make_image_hdf5.py from ~/dev/tttr-data/imaging/pq/ht3/pq_ht3_clsm.ht3 on first run. Exercises image mode and frame playback. (~/dev/tttr-data/imaging/misc/ndx_image_test.h5 is in an older layout the reader rejects.)

cal1_alex.what: ALEX/PIE calibration measurement (Cy3B/Atto647N dsDNA, 8/18/33 bp) as a .pto container: 44270 bursts with donor-only, acceptor-only and two FRET populations, the measurement Accurate FRET is meant for. It carries stored fret_calibration and background artifacts, so the ChiSurf-hosted window restores constants on open. Scenarios open a copy in the scratch $HOME (open ... copy), because the calibration is written into the container.

scenarios.title: Start-up, no data
scenarios.description: Fresh window before anything is opened: splash image in the plot area, empty axis combos, controls disabled until data arrives.

scenarios.title: File > Import > Analysis-Folder (burst folder)
scenarios.description: Open the MFD burst-analysis folder through the File menu. Equations add derived columns; default axes from mfd.settings.json (Tau (green) vs Proximity ratio, weight Number of Photons); marginals top/right; counts 12237/12237.

scenarios.title: Analysis-Folder directory picker
scenarios.description: The directory chooser that File > Import > Analysis-Folder opens (title 'Burst analysis folder'), cancelled. A fresh window already holds a hidden 1000-row placeholder dataset, so the merge question (Replace / Append) comes first; it is answered with Replace.

scenarios.title: Merge dialog when data is already loaded
scenarios.description: Opening another dataset while one is loaded asks how to merge: Replace / Append as columns / Append as rows.

scenarios.title: File > Import > Import Text files (CSV)
scenarios.description: Open iris.csv through the CSV import; generic columns, auto axes.

scenarios.title: CSV file picker
scenarios.description: The file chooser of File > Import > Import Text files (filter 'Text files (*.csv *.dat *.er4 *.txt)'), cancelled. A fresh window already holds a hidden 1000-row placeholder dataset, so the merge question (Replace / Append) comes first; it is answered with Replace.

scenarios.title: Single .bur file via `ndx --file` (CLI / drop path)
scenarios.description: The m000.bur file opened the way `python -m ndxplorer --file m000.bur` and a file drop do (open_path_like_drop).

scenarios.title: File > Import > ChiSurf-Sampling
scenarios.description: ChiSurf sampling folder (.er4 MCMC samples) imported through the menu. The loaded state keeps range 0..1 on chi2 x chi2 (nothing visible, Qt behaviour); then x tL1 / y chi2 and 'Auto' on both axes.

scenarios.title: File > Import > Analysis file: load error
scenarios.description: Importing an HDF5 file that holds no columnar table ends in a 'Data Load Error' box carrying the reader's reason. (The successful Analysis-file import is open_image_h5.)

scenarios.title: Image table (X/Y pixel) -> image mode
scenarios.description: An MFIS image HDF5: ndX detects the pixel axes and shows the data as an image (pixel bins, photon weighting, NaN/inf masks off).

scenarios.title: File menu (+ Import, Save submenus)
scenarios.description: File: Import > (Import Text files Ctrl+O, Analysis file, Analysis-Folder Ctrl+I, ChiSurf-Sampling); Save > (Burst IDs, Histograms); Make Report; Print window; Exit.

scenarios.title: Settings menu (+ Save settings submenu)
scenarios.description: Settings: Performance Settings, Load settings, Save settings > (Axis settings, Constants, Equations), Set default axis.

scenarios.title: View menu
scenarios.description: View: panel toggles (Plot controls, Parameters, Overlays, Fit Gaussians, Equations), UMAP, Find informative projections…, Find informative projections (z axis)…, Axis Control.

scenarios.title: Help menu
scenarios.description: Help: Help, Fix Report Tool, About, Update.

scenarios.title: Set x/y parameters: Fd/Fa vs Tau (green)
scenarios.description: Choose the classic MFD view in the axis combos; per-parameter axis settings (mfd.axis.json) make y logarithmic 0.1..500.

scenarios.title: Axis scale, normalisation, bins and ranges
scenarios.description: Log x axis, normalised y marginal, 2-D bins 61x61, 1-D bins 121, manual x range 0.5..5.

scenarios.title: Weighted histograms
scenarios.description: 'weight' checked, histograms weighted by Number of Photons.

scenarios.title: Colormap, log counts, auto contrast, vmin/vmax
scenarios.description: Colormap 'inferno' and the Contrast button (auto vmin/vmax), then 'log #' on. Note: log # does not re-derive vmin/vmax, so after Contrast the log map saturates (Qt behaviour).

scenarios.title: NaN / inf masking off
scenarios.description: Unchecking NaN and inf keeps non-finite rows (count field changes).

scenarios.title: Rectangular gate dragged on the 2-D plot
scenarios.description: Drag a rectangle around the FRET population: two rectangular gates (x and y parameter) appear in the Selection table; plots show only gated bursts; count updates.

scenarios.title: Gate table: invert and disable
scenarios.description: Two gates; the y gate inverted, the x gate disabled via the table's Invert/Enable check boxes.

scenarios.title: Selection table context menu
scenarios.description: Right-click menu of the gate table: Select All, Clear, Delete, Send selection to ▸.

scenarios.title: 2-D canvas context menu
scenarios.description: Right-click on the 2-D histogram: Copy 2D Histogram (CSV), Copy 1D Histograms (CSV), Send to Napari, Fit gate to the population here, Send selection to ▸.

scenarios.title: Fit gate to the population here
scenarios.description: Context menu > 'Fit gate to the population here' on the FRET population. Qt: broken - the view box of the 2-D map is in bin indices while the check compares against data ranges, so every canvas pick is refused ('That click maps to (18.59, 8.69), outside the plotted range'; shot 'refused'). The model half, pick_population_at(x, y) in data units, is then called at the FRET population (Tau 3.2 ns, PR 0.35) to record the fitted elliptical gate.

steps.text: Fit gate to the population here

scenarios.title: z axis panel: dynamic z-selection
scenarios.description: Expand 'z axis', enable dynamic z-selection on r Experimental (green), turn on dynamic selection so the z range gates the 2-D/1-D plots.

scenarios.title: z range -> gate ('select')
scenarios.description: The z panel's 'select' button turns the current z range into a rectangular gate in the Selection table.

scenarios.title: Draw Mask panel: paint and apply
scenarios.description: Expand 'Draw Mask', enable drawing, paint a stroke over the FRET population with brush 5, category 1, then Apply -> mask gate. Qt: broken - the strokes never register because PGImageWidget.invTransform raises NameError (_QWT_X_BOTTOM undefined), so the 'painted' shot shows no mask and Apply adds nothing.

scenarios.title: Playback panel (window mode)
scenarios.description: Expand 'Playback': Axis (defaults to the macro-time column), Steps, Step slider, transport ◀◀ ◀ ⏸ ▶ ▶▶, Mode Window/Integrate/Stack, Speed. Window mode, stepped forward 5 times.

scenarios.title: Playback over image frames
scenarios.description: Image data: the playback axis is the Frame column (10 steps, one per frame); integrate mode stepped forward 5 times (frames 0..5 accumulated).

scenarios.title: Clustering dialog ('Find structure'), every method page
scenarios.description: Selection panel 'Cluster' button opens the non-modal dialog. Pages: K-means (default), PCA, UMAP (+Advanced), HDBSCAN.

scenarios.title: Column selection dialog
scenarios.description: Clustering dialog > '▦ Columns' opens 'Select Columns for Clustering': filter box, one check box per column, Select All / Deselect All, OK/Cancel.

scenarios.title: K-means clustering run, clusters coloured (iris)
scenarios.description: K-means (k=3) on iris petal length + petal width, run from the dialog; 'colour' on so the 2-D map is coloured by cluster; then the cluster spin box isolates cluster 1. (On the raw MFD columns k-means is dominated by outliers - 12232/1/4 - so iris, with a known 3-group answer, is used.)

steps.expr: win._cluster_labels is not None and not (win.clustering_worker and win.clustering_worker.isRunning())

scenarios.title: PCA run: loadings report
scenarios.description: PCA on six MFD parameters; the dialog reports which parameters carry the variance and adds PC columns.

scenarios.title: UMAP via the clustering dialog
scenarios.description: UMAP page, four MFD columns, '▶ Run'. The baseline environment has no umap-learn, so Run ends in the installer's 'Installation was cancelled or failed, so this method cannot run.' box - that is what is recorded. The progress dialog ('UMAP Column Computation') is captured from the window's own factory so its layout is on record. With umap-learn installed, Run adds UMAP_1/UMAP_2 columns and '📈 Plot' opens a 'UMAP Projection' window (not in this baseline).

scenarios.title: View > UMAP
scenarios.description: The View menu UMAP entry. In the Qt app it calls umap_helpers.on_show_umap, which does not exist (AttributeError, nothing opens) - UMAP is only reachable via the clustering dialog. The port should make this entry open UMAP.

scenarios.title: Gaussian Fit panel: fit 2-D Gaussians
scenarios.description: View > Fit Gaussians shows the 'Gaussian Fit' tab; '🎯 Fit' fits a GMM to the 2-D histogram: ellipses on the map, marginal Gaussians, parameter table (x, y, σx, σy, ρ, w per component).

scenarios.title: Gaussian Fit: turn a component into a gate
scenarios.description: After fitting, '🔍 Select' with Selection σ = 2 turns the Gaussian into an elliptical gate in the Selection table.

scenarios.title: GMM Settings dialog
scenarios.description: Gaussian Fit '⚙ Settings'. In the Qt app the button is dead (it imports gaussian_settings_dialog from the wrong package and swallows the ImportError); the dialog is constructed directly so its controls are on record.

steps.code:
from ndxplorer.ui.gaussian_settings_dialog import GaussianSettingsDialog
h._gmm = GaussianSettingsDialog(parent=win)
h._gmm.show()
h._register(h._gmm)

scenarios.title: Overlays: static FRET line on Fd/Fa vs Tau
scenarios.description: Overlays tab: pick 'FD/FA vs tau (static line)' from the Equation combo, 'Add Curve'; the curve is drawn on the 2-D map; the curve group shows Equation/Filled fields, Color, Fit, Delete and its parameter table.

scenarios.title: Overlays: predefined equation list
scenarios.description: The Equation combo's items: Custom Equation plus the curve_equations.yaml set.

scenarios.title: Fit curve to data dialog
scenarios.description: A curve's 'Fit' button opens 'Fit curve to data': Fit to (2d / x / y marginal), Fit through (cloud / population / mean), Scan first, parameter table(s), status, Fit / Close.

scenarios.title: Parameters tab (constants)
scenarios.description: The constants table (gG/gR, Bg, Br, By, PhiA, PhiD, alpha, tauD0, beta, r, forster_radius, ...) with Name/Value/Fixed/Lo/Hi/Bounds, 'Add parameter' and 'Save'.

scenarios.title: Parameters: Add parameter prompt
scenarios.description: 'Add parameter' asks for a name (QInputDialog) then a value.

scenarios.title: Equations tab and names dialog
scenarios.description: The equation table (Output, Expression, status), ➕ ➖ 🔤 and Apply; 🔤 opens 'Names & functions'. Qt: View > Equations is dead since the docks became DockArea tabs (the action toggles its check mark, the hidden tab never appears), so no user can reach this panel; the harness triggers the action (to prove it does nothing) and then shows the tab through the dock area.

scenarios.title: Data button -> Table Editor
scenarios.description: 'Data' opens the Table Editor over a copy of the data: search, column picker, hide empty, colour by value, export, sortable table, Reset / Apply / Cancel.

scenarios.title: View > Axis Control
scenarios.description: Axis visibility per plot (X/Y/Z/2D/Overlay), axis-label toggles, font settings (tick size, title size, bold, colour); OK / Save / Cancel / Apply.

scenarios.title: Settings > Performance Settings
scenarios.description: Histogram computation (fast histogram, parallel, threads, plot backend), memory & caching, advanced info; Reset / Cancel / Apply / OK.

scenarios.title: Export… (publication figure)
scenarios.description: The 'Export…' button next to Screenshot: format (PDF/SVG vector or PNG raster), DPI, marginals, size options.

scenarios.title: Screenshot button
scenarios.description: 'Screenshot' asks for a file name (PNG/JPEG/BMP) and saves the plot area.

scenarios.title: File > Make Report
scenarios.description: 'ndX Report Tool': analysis-folder list (drop / Add… / Remove / Clear), report.yaml editor (Load… / Save…), generated-image browser, Clear Reports / Generate Reports.

scenarios.title: Help > Fix Report Tool
scenarios.description: In the Qt app this imports a module that does not exist and shows a 'Fix Report Tool Error' box. Recorded so the port decides: implement or drop the entry.

scenarios.title: View > Find informative projections…
scenarios.description: VizRank window (already emtk/AutoForm, hosted in Qt): Rank by Separation (default) | Correlation | Classes, Bursts, Sample, Start/Pause, status, ranked x/y table with an Islands column. Ranked on MFD data (a gate makes Classes available; Separation stays the default).

scenarios.title: Find informative projections on iris (class separation)
scenarios.description: Iris with its class column as the z parameter: Rank by 'Classes', Classes 'z parameter: class' (set on the panel's view model, which is what the two choice widgets bind to), Start. Known answer: the petal pair separates best.

steps.code:
m = win.projection_rank.dialogs[True].model
m.refresh_context()
m.method = 'separation'
m.classes = 'z parameter: class'
m.settings_changed()

scenarios.title: View > Find informative projections (z axis)…
scenarios.description: The z-parameter variant: ranks every parameter as the third axis (Parameter column instead of x/y).

scenarios.title: Save Burst IDs ('BID' / File > Save > Burst IDs)
scenarios.description: Gate, then 'BID': choose a folder, the BST files are written, then 'Process Burst IDs' offers microtime histogram / FCS correlator.

scenarios.title: Settings > Set default axis
scenarios.description: Stores the current x/y/z/weight as default axes and reports it in a message box.

scenarios.title: Settings > Load settings
scenarios.description: File chooser for an ndX settings file.

scenarios.title: Settings > Save settings > Axis settings
scenarios.description: Save-file chooser for the per-parameter axis settings.

scenarios.title: Browse (working path)
scenarios.description: 'Browse' next to the Path field opens a directory chooser.

scenarios.title: Selection 'save' (gates to *.selection.json)
scenarios.description: The Selection panel's 'save' asks where to write the gates.

scenarios.title: Clear
scenarios.description: 'Clear' resets the plots and the working path.

scenarios.title: ChiSurf-hosted window: the toolbars and constants ChiSurf adds
scenarios.description: ndX opened from ChiSurf's ribbon (the plugin __init__ run with __name__ == 'plugin'): rpc_bridge.make_ndxplorer adds the ChiSurf Phasor toolbar and restores the calibration stored in the opened .pto; the plugin adds the Accurate FRET toolbar (FRET calibration, Save calibration, Load calibration, Sync constants) and publishes the constants to the Global View. The MMFDB toolbar is added only when MMFDB answers mmfdb.status.

scenarios.title: Accurate FRET > FRET calibration: the options dialog
scenarios.description: 'FRET calibration' first asks what the calibration may write (calibration_options.view.json through AutoForm): the factor toggles, the background source, the collapsed 'How' panel and 'When it finishes'. Cancel leaves the window unchanged.

scenarios.title: Accurate FRET > FRET calibration: a real run and its report
scenarios.description: Accept the options with their defaults (all four factors, background 'fit', 50 bootstrap resamples, store in the measurement): the calibration runs with a progress bar, writes the factors into the constants, adds the accurate columns and opens the report window (factors with uncertainties, populations, constants before -> after, fitted background, new columns, where it was stored) with Save calibration... / Save report... / Close.

steps.expr: any('FRET calibration' in w.windowTitle() and w.isVisible() and w.findChild(QtWidgets.QPlainTextEdit) is not None for w in h.opened)

steps.code:
d = [w for w in h.opened if w.findChild(QtWidgets.QPlainTextEdit) is not None][-1]
h.log['report'] = d.findChild(QtWidgets.QPlainTextEdit).toPlainText()
h.log['report_status'] = [l.text() for l in d.findChildren(QtWidgets.QLabel) if l.text()]

scenarios.title: Accurate FRET > Save calibration / Load calibration
scenarios.description: Save asks whether to store into the measurement (Yes) or a separate *.fretcal.json file (No), then says where it went. Load first offers the newest calibration stored in the measurement (Yes) or a file (No), then shows what would change and asks before applying; a stored report opens in the report window.

steps.name: save_question
steps.target: dialog:Store the calibration in the measurement?

scenarios.title: MMFDB > Open from MMFDB (ChiSurf-hosted)
scenarios.description: The plugin adds an 'MMFDB' toolbar with 'Open from MMFDB' (dataset picker -> mmfdb.datasets.open -> open like a drop) only when MMFDBClient(inprocess=True).status() succeeds. The client it builds has no session token and mmfdb.status requires one, so the toolbar is not added: the log's toolbars list records that.

steps.code: h.log['mmfdb_toolbar'] = [t for t in h.toolbars() if t['name'] == 'ndxplorerMmfdbToolbar']

scenarios.title: ChiSurf Phasor > Phasor / FRET... (ChiSurf-hosted)
scenarios.description: The in-process ChiSurf client (rpc_bridge) gives the window the 'ChiSurf Phasor' toolbar (ndxplorer/ui/phasor_toolbar.py, installed when ndx.phasor_service exists): 'Phasor / FRET...' shows the phasor / FRET-line control panel, a dock of the window, 'Clear' removes the overlays.
